reviews.title: Helpful for my aphasia recovery—audio would make it better
reviews.text:
I have aphasia, and Nibble has been really helpful as I practice reading and speaking again. The short lessons give me interesting things to learn and talk about, like animals, psychology, and the human body. I feel they’re helping me use more words.

Reading is still very difficult for me. A lesson listed as 9–10 minutes can take me an hour. I would love a read-aloud feature so I could listen while following the text, plus the option to tap a single word to hear how it sounds. Apple’s reading tools don’t always work well with the content.

It’s a good app that has helped me a lot. These audio features would make it much easier for me to use.

reviews.title: WARNING: HIDDEN WEB SUBSCRIPTION SCAM!
reviews.text:
Do not trust this app! They run a massive billing trap. If you take their quiz or click an ad online, they sign you up for a hidden web subscription that does NOT show up in your Apple ID.
Even if you download the app and cancel your trial through Apple (and get the cancellation email), they will STILL secretly charge your credit card for a full-priced web subscription. They run two separate billing systems to trick you into thinking you are canceled while they keep stealing your money. Customer service is unhelpful and refuses refunds. Avoid at all costs, or check your bank statements carefully!
